name: ELDEN RING (offline only)
warning: The merged copy always starts offline through Mod Engine 2, without Easy Anti-Cheat, so it can never go online. Never copy its save back into your normal game by hand: modded saves online can get you banned.

frameworks.name: Mod Engine 2 (loads mods offline, without Easy Anti-Cheat)
Elden Ring Practice Tool (Creative tools: item spawner, fly, no damage)

themes.name: Hogwarts Legacy: wand, spells, houses and a broom
themes.description: The Lands Between as a wizarding school's battleground: a wand that casts Hogwarts spells as sorceries, a house pick at character creation with its robes, stats and house spell, Torrent flying like a broom in Creative, and the wizarding world's creatures played by Elden Ring's own. Built from Elden Ring's own items; nothing is copied out of Hogwarts Legacy.

slots.name: Wand and Hogwarts spells
slots.builtin: Frankenstein's own Elden Ring mod: every house starts with a wand (the Astrologer's Staff) and the spellbook as sorceries: Stupefy = Glintstone Pebble, Lumos = Starlight, Protego = Thops's Barrier, Expelliarmus = Carian Retaliation, Depulso = Rock Blaster, Incendio = Magma Shot, Accio = Gravity Well, Glacius = Freezing Mist, Bombarda = Cannon of Haima. In game they keep Elden Ring's names (its text is locked in the game's archives).

slots.name: House pick with robes and a house spell
slots.builtin: Frankenstein's own Elden Ring mod: four starting classes become the houses. Hero = Gryffindor (Spellblade's red hat and attire, Incendio), Prisoner = Slytherin (Alberich's pointed hat and robe, Expelliarmus), Astrologer = Ravenclaw (Astrologer hood and Raya Lucarian robe, Glacius), Confessor = Hufflepuff (Sage hood and robe, Protego), each with its own stats. The robes are Elden Ring's closest ones, not recoloured.

slots.name: Broom (Torrent)
slots.builtin: Creative tools: Torrent flies like a broom (F3, or Broom on the controller wheel). Out of Creative Torrent rides as normal and keeps his own look; a broom model needs a mod (picks below).

slots.name: Creatures of the wizarding world
slots.builtin: Stand-in: Elden Ring's own creatures play the parts (trolls are trolls, Death Rite Birds and Night's Cavalry are the dementor-like hunters, skeletons are the Inferi). Their names and colours stay Elden Ring's.

slots.name: Creative tools and item spawner
slots.builtin: Frankenstein's Creative tools (the Elden Ring Practice Tool, set up by Frankenstein): item spawner with every item, no damage, unlimited FP, fly, speed, +100,000 runes and warp. Keys 1-9 and F1-F4, 0 opens the menu, both sticks open the controller wheel.

multiplayer: Merged Elden Ring copies are offline only: Mod Engine 2 starts them without Easy Anti-Cheat, so FromSoftware's online play is off. Co-op with mods needs the community's Seamless Co-op mod on every player's PC (from Nexus, by hand).

sandbox.native: Creative is in the game on every Play (Elden Ring Practice Tool, set up by Frankenstein): press both sticks on a controller for the Creative wheel, or 0 for its menu. Item spawner (Ctrl+U), no damage (1), unlimited FP (3), fly (F2), Torrent flies like a broom (F3), speed (8), +100,000 runes (9).
sandbox.note: Offline only, always. Creative works on your existing characters too: the merge starts with a copy of your Elden Ring saves.
